# autossh

This mod adds autossh to openssh-server, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `openssh-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:openssh-server-autossh
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:openssh-server-autossh|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/openssh-server-autossh/
